name: Opportunity to Closed Won Deal Workflow
description: Verify Account -> Contact -> Opp -> Deal -> Closed Won -> Dashboard Revenue update

planSteps.description: Register user 'sprite_won@example.com' for company 'Won Deals Corp'
Navigate to /accounts and create account 'Won Account Enterprise'
Navigate to /pipeline and create opportunity 'Enterprise License Opp' for account 'Won Account Enterprise' with amount 500000
Open Enterprise License Opp detail page and click Convert to Deal button
Verify redirection to Deal Detail page with deal name Enterprise License Opp
Verify Enterprise License Opp appears in Won Deals list with amount 500,000
Verify Closed Won Revenue metric displays 500,000
